verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official CLI for Windows, PowerShell, documented on Microsoft Learn. That is first-party, but it is a single thin pointer with no detail on capabilities or AI-native and agentic use. missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage, guidance for agent or AI-driven use of the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
